description: Search official Commons or Lords division summaries, or use detail, voters or party_totals with a divisionId from the same House. Search supports title/number text, member and inclusive division dates; member searches include memberVote with the recorded House-native lobby and teller flag. Detail preserves complete metadata and teller identities, with roster selectors for voters mode. Voters can filter exact source party labels and House-compatible lobbies. not_recorded means only the source list, never abstention. Party totals count listed non-tellers and tellers separately from official headline counts. Follow collection cursors with unchanged filters; reconstruct oversized content using contentCursor.
